params.description: AI Employee id (from list_ai_personas) to run this schedule as — applies its personality, model, and tool scopes. Empty string clears it, so the schedule runs as the default agent.

params.name: model
params.description: Omit to inherit. 'auto': a router picks the cheapest model per run. claude-haiku-4-5 for simple list/summarize/remind runs; Sonnet for drafting or judgement. 'default' clears.

params.name: only_when_tasks_for
params.description: Optional. A teammate's name (as tasks are assigned — a first name is fine). When set, each run first checks that person's open tasks and SKIPS the run entirely — nothing is sent, nothing is spent — when the check finds none. Use it for per-person task reminders, or whenever the user says not to email when there's nothing to report. This is enforced before the run starts, so do not also tell the run to skip itself. Empty string turns the check off, so the schedule runs every time.

params.name: task_gate
params.description: 'open' (default) runs only if the person has any open task; 'due' runs only if they have a task due today or overdue (or within tasks_due_within_days) — tasks with no due date never count, so use 'due' only when the user asks for it ('only if something is due').

params.name: tasks_due_within_days
params.description: With task_gate 'due': how many days ahead still count as due (0 = due today or overdue, the default; 7 = anything due this week). 0–30.

tools.name: update_ai_persona
tools.description: Update an existing AI Employee's configuration (name, role, instructions, model, capabilities, access list, enabled, reporting line). Workspace owners and admins only. Only the fields you pass are changed. Pass allowed_scopes as an empty array to reset the employee back to inheriting every capability. Cannot edit the AI Employee currently running this conversation, and cannot edit a member's digital twin.

params.name: persona_id
params.description: UUID of the employee to update.

params.name: persona_name
params.description: Exact name of the employee, if you don't have the id.

params.name: name
params.description: New display name.

params.name: role_title
params.description: New job title.

params.name: personality
params.description: Replacement instructions/personality block.

params.name: model
params.description: New model override.

params.name: allowed_scopes
params.description: Replacement capability list (replaces, does not merge). Empty array = inherit everything. Available: tasks_projects (Tasks & projects: Create/update tasks, manage projects, sprints, dependencies, statuses, swimlanes); communications (Chat & discussions: Workspace chat, discussion threads, notifications, inbox, message templates); email_calendar (Email & calendar: Connected Gmail/Proton/AngelSend mail, Google Calendar, scheduled emails); dev_github (Developer & GitHub: Cloudcode, multiverseAI, linked dev accounts); workflows_automations (Workflows & automations: Automation rules, proactive agent, recurring tasks, background jobs, Scrappy scraping engine (sources/jobs)); reports_analytics (Reports & analytics: Reports, portfolio, time tracking, capacity, audit search); crm (Clients & deals: CRM — clients, client portal members, deals pipeline, Scrappy lead funnel (leads/accounts/campaigns)); finance (Finance & accounting: ClearBooks — invoices, transactions, GL, cap table, metrics, banking, ACH); knowledge_files (Knowledge & files: Knowledge base, project files, templates, resource requests, Scrappy website→markdown exports); admin (Administration: Governance, SLA policies, support, undo stack, jira-parity admin)

params.name: member_user_ids
params.description: Replacement access list. Empty array opens the employee to all workspace members.

params.name: avatar_prompt
params.description: New stored visual description.

params.name: security_guardrails
params.description: Replacement free-text safety rules.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Switch the employee on or off.

params.name: reports_to
params.description: The AI Employee this one reports to, by id or exact name; pass an empty string to remove its manager. Refused if it would make a loop (the proposed manager already reports up to this employee) or names itself.

tools.name: update_automation
tools.description: Update an automation rule's name, trigger, action, or enabled state. trigger_type and action_type use the same vocabulary as create_automation.

tools.name: update_boardroom
tools.description: Change a standing exec meeting: rename it, reset the agenda or chair, change the cadence, change how many discussion rounds it runs, replace who sits at the table, or arm/disarm it. Only the fields you pass change. Passing `seats` REPLACES the whole table, so include every exec who should stay.

params.name: boardroom
params.description: The boardroom's id, or its exact name.

params.name: kind
params.description: What kind of standing meeting this is. exec (default): executives give a performance update. board: directors review the North Star and the strategy and endorse or flag it (advisory to the humans). department: a VP and their directors review the team. standup: a short daily done/next/blocked check-in for an IC team — pair it with frequency 'weekdays' and 0 discussion rounds.

params.name: model
params.description: Optional model for every seat in this series: a model id, 'auto' (a router picks the cheapest model that fits), or 'default' to use each employee's own model / the workspace background model. A cheaper model makes a stand-up much cheaper.

params.name: seats
params.description: Replaces the entire table (2-6 seats). Include everyone who should remain seated.

params.name: day_of_week
params.description: For weekly: 0=Sunday … 6=Saturday.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Arm or disarm the meeting. Arming means it starts meeting on its cadence and spending on model usage every time — only set true when the user has clearly asked for that.

tools.name: update_client
tools.description: Update fields on an existing client. Provide only fields to change. To change the client's links use set_client_links instead.

params.name: logo_url
params.description: Direct URL of an image to use as the client's logo. Leave unset to keep the automatic behavior (the logo is derived from the website's OpenGraph image or favicon). Pass an empty string to clear an override and go back to auto-detection.

tools.name: update_component
tools.description: Patch a component by id. archived=true hides it from default listings without deleting.

tools.name: update_custom_property
tools.description: Patch a custom property definition (admin-only). Only provided fields change.

tools.name: update_custom_status
tools.description: Rename, recolor, or otherwise edit an existing custom status. Only the fields you pass are changed; omit fields you want to leave alone. Pass `wip_limit: null` to clear the WIP cap.

params.name: id
params.description: The custom status row id (UUID).

params.name: name
params.description: New display name.

params.name: slug
params.description: New slug. Lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only. Must remain unique within the project.

params.name: color
params.description: New hex color (e.g. '#65d38c').

params.name: wip_limit
params.description: New WIP cap. Pass null to clear the cap.

tools.name: update_deal
tools.description: Write to a Deal Room deal: change any subset of its fields in one call — probability, stage, name (the deal's title), notes (its description), amount, fee revenue, expected close, owner, category, closers, sector / issuance stage / geography, custom fields, or a forecast hold. Only the fields you pass change. Money is in DOLLARS (not cents); revenue_dollars is the FEE, amount_dollars is the deal size — never put one in the other. Pass `reason` whenever the change comes from analysis rather than a direct instruction: it is written onto the deal's timeline with your change, which is the audit trail a desk reads later. Returns the updated deal with every field and the time of the update. `probability` is the desk's own number and feeds weighted pipeline totals; the calculated forecast lives separately (get_deal_forecast / recalculate_deal_forecast) — do not copy forecast output into probability unless the user asks for exactly that. Always pass expected_deal_name — the current name of the deal the user means — alongside deal_id: a wrong id (say, from a deal you created earlier in the conversation) is then refused instead of silently overwriting the wrong deal.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: The deal's id, as list_deals prints it.

params.name: expected_deal_name
params.description: ALWAYS pass the CURRENT name of the deal you mean to change (the one the user chose). If deal_id resolves to a deal with a different name, nothing is written and you are told both names — the guard against editing a deal you created or read earlier by mistake. When renaming, this is the OLD name.

params.name: name
params.description: The deal's title.

params.name: stage
params.description: Move to this stage (id or slug, same pipeline). Records a stage change and fires stage automations, exactly like update_deal_stage.

params.name: amount_dollars
params.description: Deal size (transaction amount) in dollars.

params.name: revenue_dollars
params.description: Fee revenue to the firm in dollars.

params.name: probability
params.description: Close probability, 0–100. Null clears it (the stage default then applies in weighted totals).

params.name: expected_close
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD or null.

params.name: category
params.description: Line of business ('Series A', 'Secondaries'). Free text; null clears it.

params.name: notes
params.description: The deal's notes / description. REPLACES the whole field — to add a line, read the deal first and send the full new text.

params.name: sector
params.description: Sector tag used for broker-dealer and investor matching (e.g. 'defense', 'fintech').

params.name: issuance_stage
params.description: Issuance stage used for matching (e.g. 'series b', 'growth').

params.name: geography
params.description: Geography used for matching (e.g. 'us', 'europe').

params.name: custom_fields
params.description: Named per-deal fields shown on the deal in Deal Room, merged into the existing ones: { "Vitality Score": "80%", "RR": "Augustine" }. Values are strings, numbers or booleans; null removes a field. Up to 50 fields.

params.name: forecast_hold
params.description: True keeps the deal OUT of the revenue forecast (a compliance hold, a counterparty who is really staff) until set back to false. Give forecast_hold_reason.

params.name: forecast_hold_reason
params.description: Why the deal is held out of the forecast, e.g. 'Compliance hold — Umergence clearance pending'.

params.name: reason
params.description: Why this change is being made. Written to the deal's timeline alongside the change.

tools.name: update_deal_cadence
tools.description: Change an existing cadence: include_unsubscribe, booking_url (what {{booking_link}} renders to), name, description, enabled state, or its steps (the WHOLE list, same fields as create_deal_cadence). Admin only. A network cadence always carries the unsubscribe link and cannot turn it off. A step that renders {{booking_link}} is refused unless the cadence has a booking_url, in both directions of the edit.

params.name: cadence
params.description: Cadence id or exact name.

params.name: booking_url
params.description: A public https URL, or null to clear it.

params.name: enabled
params.description: false stops every active enrollment on its next cycle.

params.name: steps
params.description: The WHOLE new step list (1–8), replacing the old one. Same step fields as create_deal_cadence.

tools.name: update_deal_contact
tools.description: Update an investor/contact's per-deal working state: their own status within this deal (free text — e.g. 'Contacted', 'Soft-circled', 'Committed', 'Passed'), the next step and its due date, and the contact-level relationship status ('Warm', 'Cold', 'Strong'). Status and next-step live on the deal↔contact link, so the same investor can sit at different statuses on different deals. Pass null to clear a field.

params.name: status
params.description: This investor's position in THIS deal.

params.name: next_step_due
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: relationship_status
params.description: Contact-level warmth, shared across deals.

tools.name: update_deal_stage
tools.description: Move a deal to a new stage. Triggers a stage_change activity row and (if the new stage is won/lost) marks the deal closed.

params.name: stage
params.description: Stage id or slug in the same pipeline.

tools.name: update_deal_team
tools.description: Change who on OUR side is on a deal: add members (each with an optional title for what they do on this deal), remove members, or set the lead. The lead is the deal's owner — setting it here is the same write as update_deal's owner, and the previous lead stays on the team as a member. Each `member` and `lead` is resolved against the workspace's ACTIVE members: an exact email, then an exact display name (case-insensitive), then a unique name prefix. An ambiguous name is refused with the candidates listed, and a person who is not an active member cannot be added. All-or-nothing: if any name fails to resolve, nothing is changed. get_deal shows the team.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: The deal's id, as list_deals prints it.

params.name: add
params.description: People to add to the team, or whose title on this deal to change.

params.name: remove
params.description: People to take off the team (name, email or user id each).

params.name: lead
params.description: Name, email or user id of the new lead; null clears the lead. Omit to leave the lead alone.

params.name: reason
params.description: Why the change is being made. Written onto the deal's timeline with a lead change.

tools.name: update_decision
tools.description: Patch a decision by id. Useful for marking superseded.

tools.name: update_department
tools.description: Rename a department, change its description, or re-parent it. Pass only the fields you want to change.

params.name: department_id
params.description: Target department UUID

params.name: department_name
params.description: Target department name (alternative to department_id)

params.name: new_name
params.description: New name

params.name: new_description
params.description: New description

params.name: parent_department_id
params.description: New parent department UUID (empty string to clear)

params.name: parent_department_name
params.description: New parent department name (alternative to parent_department_id)

tools.name: update_document_block_comment
tools.description: Edit a block comment body and/or toggle its resolved state. resolved=true marks the thread done; resolved=false reopens it.

tools.name: update_escalation_rule
tools.description: Update an escalation rule by id.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update a goal's target, threshold, comparator, due date, unit, description, or status ('met'/'missed'/'archived' to close it out).

tools.name: update_inbound_request_status
tools.description: Update an inbound request's review status (new → in_review → resolved/archived). First move out of 'new' stamps first_responded_at; entering resolved/archived stamps resolved_at.

tools.name: update_investor_match_status
tools.description: Mark where a firm stands on a deal: 'approached' once outreach has actually gone out, or 'dismissed' when it should not be contacted about this deal. Both clear the firm from the working set, which is what lets the next tranche be released. Dismissed is durable — a later re-ranking will not resurrect it. You rarely need 'approached' for a cadence: the 6-hourly scan sets it once a step has actually been sent to someone at the firm on this deal. Use it for outreach that happened outside a cadence (a call, a personal email).

tools.name: update_issuer_match_status
tools.description: Mark where a prospect stands in a campaign: 'approached' once outreach went out outside a cadence (a call, a personal email), 'engaged' when they responded through a channel the sync cannot see (a phone call, a conference), or 'dismissed' when they should not be contacted. All three clear the firm from the working set, which is what lets the next tranche release. Dismissed is durable — a later re-ranking will not resurrect it. You rarely need the first two for a cadence: the 6-hourly scan sets approached from real sends and engaged from real replies and meetings. When a prospect becomes a client, use convert_issuer_to_deal instead.

params.name: campaign
params.description: Campaign id or exact name.

tools.name: update_knowledge_document
tools.description: Patch a knowledge document. Only provided fields are written. Pass `blocks` to replace the entire block body; passing `body` instead patches the legacy markdown column. Setting is_template=true on a published doc also unpublishes it and clears outbound backlinks.

params.name: blocks

tools.name: update_my_note

params.name: title

params.name: body

tools.name: update_my_reminder

tools.name: update_my_todo
tools.description: Update one of the caller's own to-do items by id. Only fields you pass are changed. Personal data only.

params.name: id

params.name: text
params.description: New to-do text.

params.name: done
params.description: Mark the to-do done (or not done).

params.name: sort_order
params.description: New sort order (lower sorts first).

tools.name: update_objective
tools.description: Update an objective's title, description, progress (0-100), status, target date, or linked project refs.

params.name: target_date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD or null to clear

tools.name: update_pipeline_stage
tools.description: Rename, reorder, recolor, or reclassify a pipeline stage. params.name: default_probability

tools.name: update_program

tools.name: update_project_folder

tools.name: update_proof_annotation

params.name: cron_expression

tools.name: update_recurring_task

tools.name: update_report_schedule

tools.name: update_request_field

Only the properties you pass are changed; the field's key, kind, options, order, and visibility rule are preserved. Use set_request_field_visibility to change conditional visibility.

params.name: label

params.name: is_required

params.name: placeholder
params.description: Placeholder text, or null to clear it. Omit to leave unchanged.

params.name: help_text
params.description: Help text shown under the field, or null to clear it. Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: update_resolution
tools.description: Patch a resolution by id. is_default=true clears the flag on every other resolution.

tools.name: update_role
tools.description: Update a custom RBAC role's name, description, and/or permission map. Changing permissions changes what every member assigned this role can access. System roles cannot be edited. Requires workspace owner/admin.

params.name: role_id
params.description: Id (UUID) of the custom role to update.

params.name: name
params.description: New role name.

params.name: description
params.description: New description.

params.name: permissions
params.description: New permission map (fully replaces the existing one). Keyed by resource → { view, create, edit, delete } booleans.

tools.name: update_saved_view
tools.description: Patch fields on a saved view. Only the owner can edit (admins can override). Pass only fields you want to change.

tools.name: update_sla_policy
tools.description: Update an SLA policy by id.

tools.name: update_sprint
tools.description: Update a sprint's fields. Setting status='completed' with completed_points will record velocity.

tools.name: update_support_ticket_status
tools.description: Update a support ticket's status and optionally attach a resolution note explaining what was done — the note is shown to the reporter. Admin-only. Confirm with the user before resolving or closing tickets they didn't open.

params.name: resolution_note
params.description: What was done to resolve the ticket, written for the reporter. Shown on their own-tickets list.

tools.name: update_swimlane
tools.description: Update a swimlane's name, position, color, or archived state. Pass archived=true to hide the lane without deleting it.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update one or more fields on an existing task. Use this to move a card to a different column (`status`) or swimlane row (`swimlane_id`), or to change priority, assignee, due date, tag, emoji label, title, description, or reminder. Provide only the fields you want to change. It cannot change which project a task is in — use move_task_to_project for that.

params.name: task_id
params.description: The task ID to update

params.name: status
params.description: New status / kanban column. Use a status slug from list_custom_statuses (e.g. 'open', 'progress', 'review', 'completed', or a custom column slug like 'blocked').

params.name: swimlane_id
params.description: Move the task to a different swimlane (kanban row). Pass a swimlane id from list_swimlanes (must belong to the task's project), or null to clear and put it back in the default lane.

params.name: assigned_to
params.description: REPLACES the task's whole assignee list: comma-separated names for several people, empty string to unassign. To add or remove one person while keeping the others, use add_assignees / remove_assignees instead.

params.name: add_assignees
params.description: Names to ADD to the task's assignees, keeping everyone already on it (e.g. "also assign Marcus").

params.name: remove_assignees
params.description: Names to REMOVE from the task's assignees, keeping everyone else.

params.name: due_date
params.description: New due date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null to clear

params.name: reminder_date
params.description: Reminder time. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD (whole-day) or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (specific time, 24-hour). Null to clear.

params.name: tag
params.description: New tag/label

params.name: emoji
params.description: Emoji label pinned to the task card — a quick visual marker for the KIND of work (🔧 fix, 💻 code, 🎨 design, 🖌️ polish, ✍️ writing, 📋 admin, 📞 call, 🤝 meeting, 📊 data, 🔬 research, ⚙️ ops, 📣 marketing) or its STATE (🔴🟡🟢 RAG, 🔥 urgent, 🚨 alarm, 🧊 on ice, 🚧 blocked). One emoji. Pass null or an empty string to clear it. Any emoji works — it does NOT have to be in the workspace's custom palette; that palette only decides what the on-card picker offers as one-click options. Use list_custom_task_emojis to follow a convention this workspace has already set, and add_custom_task_emoji to make one a one-click option for the team.

tools.name: update_task_type
tools.description: Patch a task type by id. is_default=true also clears the flag on every other type.

tools.name: update_time_entry
tools.description: Correct an existing time entry — its narrative, duration, date, task, billable flag, or client. Only the fields you pass change; everything else is left alone. `hours` replaces the billed quantity (decimal "0.3" or clock "1:30") and the workspace rounding policy is re-applied; pass started_at/ended_at instead to move when the work happened. Refuses an entry that is already invoiced — unbill it first — and a member may only edit their own entries. Use this for "that should have been 0.5, not 1.5"; use split_time_entry when one block was really several pieces of work.

params.name: entry_id
params.description: The entry's id (from list_active_timers or the timesheet).

params.name: description
params.description: Replacement billing narrative — what was actually done.

params.name: hours
params.description: Replacement decimal hours ("0.3", 1.5) or clock form ("1:30").

params.name: started_at
params.description: ISO timestamp — move when the work began.

params.name: ended_at
params.description: ISO timestamp — move when the work ended.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Re-point at another task, or null to detach.

params.name: project_ref
params.description: Move the entry to another project.

params.name: billable
params.description: Mark the entry billable or not.

params.name: client_id
params.description: Attribute directly to a client (from list_clients).

tools.name: update_version
tools.description: Patch a version by id. Setting status='released' stamps released_at; 'unreleased' clears it.

params.name: status
params.description: unreleased | released | archived

tools.name: update_weekly_checkin_draft
tools.description: Edit a DRAFT weekly check-in: replace its summary markdown and/or its recipient list. Only drafts can be edited (scheduled/sent ones are locked). Does not send anything.

params.name: id
params.description: The draft check-in id.

params.name: summary_md
params.description: New summary markdown (replaces the existing body).

params.name: recipient_user_ids
params.description: New recipient user-id list for when the check-in is later sent.

tools.name: upsert_firm
tools.description: Create a firm, or update the one that already holds this name or email domain. Resolves to an existing firm rather than creating a duplicate — pass the domain whenever you know it, because domain is a stronger identity than name (two funds can share a name; a mail domain belongs to one of them). Money fields are in DOLLARS and are converted for storage.

params.name: name
params.description: Firm name as it should display.

params.name: domain
params.description: Email domain, e.g. 'blueacre.com'. Accepts a URL or an email address and extracts the domain. Free-mail domains (gmail.com etc.) are ignored — they identify no firm.

params.name: roles
params.description: What this firm does for us. A firm can hold several roles.

params.name: aum_dollars
params.description: Assets under management, in dollars.

params.name: dry_powder_dollars
params.description: Uncalled capital available to deploy, in dollars.

params.name: thesis
params.description: What they invest in and why, in their own terms. Prose, not tags — this is what the investor scorer reads.

params.name: sectors
params.description: Lowercase tags, e.g. ['fintech','defense'].

params.name: stages
params.description: e.g. ['series-b','growth','pre-ipo'].

params.name: raise_target_dollars
params.description: ISSUERS: the raise they are targeting, in dollars. What the issuer scorer judges size fit on.

params.name: last_funding_dollars
params.description: ISSUERS: size of their last completed round, in dollars. Stands in for the raise target at half weight.

params.name: last_funding_at
params.description: ISSUERS: date the last round closed, YYYY-MM-DD. Drives timing: 15-42 months ago scores up, under 6 months scores down.

params.name: annual_revenue_dollars
params.description: ISSUERS: annual revenue, in dollars.

params.name: employee_count
params.description: ISSUERS: headcount.

params.name: raise_signal
params.description: ISSUERS: evidence they are in or about to be in market — "hired a CFO in July", "announced a Series C process". The strongest timing signal the scorer has.

tools.name: upsert_issuer_campaign
tools.description: Create an issuer campaign, or update one (by campaign id, or by exact name). A campaign is the desk's mandate for the clients it wants: `themes` in the desk's own words ("grid-scale storage", "founder-led roll-ups") matched against what each company says it does, plus sectors, stages, geographies and a raise range in DOLLARS (a prospect raising below raise_min is excluded; above raise_max is a penalty, not an exclusion). The mandate is what every ranking is arithmetic over, so write it once and carefully; re-run this when it changes and rank_issuers_for_campaign to re-score (nobody's status is reset). Optionally set the NETWORK cadence, tranche size (1-200, default 100) and contacts per firm (1-3, default 1) now — a DEAL cadence is refused, because prospects are on no deal. Creating or editing a mandate sends nothing and arms nothing; start_issuer_campaign does that. Money fields are converted to cents for storage.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Update this campaign. Omit to create, or to update by exact name.

params.name: name
params.description: Campaign name, e.g. "Series B healthtech mandate". Required when creating.

params.name: themes
params.description: 3-8 short phrases describing the ideal client, in the desk's language.

params.name: sectors
params.description: Lowercase sector tags.

params.name: stages
params.description: Raise stages the desk runs (series-b, growth, pre-ipo).

params.name: raise_min_dollars
params.description: Smallest raise the desk will run. Prospects below it are excluded from the ranking.

params.name: raise_max_dollars
params.description: Largest raise the desk is set up for. Above it is a penalty, not an exclusion.

params.name: summary
params.description: A few sentences an analyst could act on.

params.name: cadence
params.description: NETWORK cadence id or exact name to enroll released firms' contacts in. Pass null to detach.

params.name: batch_size
params.description: Firms per tranche, 1-200. Default 100.

params.name: contacts_per_firm
params.description: People enrolled per firm, 1-3. Default 1.

params.name: provider
params.description: Send provider. Defaults to auto.

tools.name: verify_email_address
tools.description: Check whether an email address is deliverable before sending to it. Costs a plan request. Worth it before a campaign: a bounce is charged against the sending domain's reputation, which every other campaign then shares. Verdicts are deliberately conservative — anything the provider is unsure about comes back 'risky' rather than 'deliverable'.

tools.name: verify_kvn_complete
tools.description: Check whether a task's K/V/N axes are all transmitted. Returns which axes are missing. Use before declaring delegation complete or before transitioning a task to In Progress.

params.name: task_id
params.description: Task to inspect.

tools.name: vote_feature_request
tools.description: Up-vote a feature request for the caller (idempotent), or withdraw the caller's vote when remove=true. Any workspace member may vote.

params.name: id
params.description: The feature request id to vote on.

params.name: remove
params.description: Pass true to withdraw the caller's up-vote. Default false (adds the vote).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live internet and get a synthesized, cited answer. Use this whenever the user asks about current events, external facts, public companies/people, prices, news, documentation, or anything that isn't stored in this workspace — and whenever your own knowledge may be outdated. Returns a concise answer plus the source URLs it used. Read-only; it never changes workspace data.

params.name: query
params.description: The search query or question, phrased naturally (e.g. 'latest Next.js 16 release notes' or 'who is the current CEO of Acme Corp').

params.name: recency
params.description: Optional: restrict results to a recency window. Use 'day' or 'week' for breaking news, 'month'/'year' for slower-moving topics. Omit for no time filter.

tools.name: whiteboard_create
tools.description: WRITE. Create a new whiteboard. Optionally attach an initial Excalidraw scene (the full {elements, appState, files} payload) as a JSON object, a project ref, and a title (defaults to "Untitled").

params.name: title
params.description: Whiteboard title. Defaults to "Untitled".

params.name: project_ref
params.description: Optional project ref to associate the whiteboard with.

params.name: scene
params.description: Optional initial Excalidraw scene — the full {elements, appState, files} document, passed through opaquely.

params.name: thumbnail
params.description: Optional thumbnail data URL.

tools.name: whiteboard_delete
tools.description: WRITE. Permanently delete a whiteboard by id.

params.name: id
params.description: The whiteboard id to delete.

tools.name: whiteboard_get
tools.description: READ-ONLY. Fetch a single whiteboard by id. Returns its title, project ref, timestamps, and a compact summary of the scene (element/file counts) rather than dumping the full Excalidraw payload.

params.name: id
params.description: The whiteboard id.

tools.name: whiteboard_list
tools.description: READ-ONLY. List all whiteboards in the current workspace (most-recently-updated first). Returns each whiteboard's id, title, optional project ref, and timestamps — not the drawing scene itself.

tools.name: whiteboard_rename
tools.description: WRITE. Rename a whiteboard (changes the title only, leaves the scene untouched).

params.name: id
params.description: The whiteboard id.

params.name: title
params.description: The new title.

tools.name: whiteboard_update_scene
tools.description: WRITE. Replace a whiteboard's scene with a new Excalidraw document (passed through opaquely). Optionally also update the title and thumbnail. Uses last-write-wins unless an expected_updated_at guard is supplied.

params.name: id
params.description: The whiteboard id to update.

params.name: scene
params.description: The full Excalidraw scene document to persist.

params.name: title
params.description: Optional new title.

params.name: thumbnail
params.description: Optional new thumbnail data URL.

params.name: expected_updated_at
params.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard: the updated_at timestamp last seen. If it no longer matches, the write is rejected as a conflict.

tools.name: xdocs_add_signature_block
tools.description: Append a place to sign (name, signature, date) to an XDocs document, bound to one recipient. Required once per SIGNER before xdocs_send_envelope on a document written from Markdown — an envelope refuses to go to a recipient with nothing to complete. Identify the recipient by recipient_id or email; optional when the document has exactly one recipient. Fails on an uploaded PDF (fields are placed by page coordinate in the editor) and on a document out for signature.

params.name: email
params.description: Identify the recipient by address instead.

params.name: heading
params.description: Label above the block, usually the party's role, e.g. 'Investor' or 'Company'. Up to 120 characters; defaults to the recipient's name.

tools.name: xdocs_analytics_summary
tools.description: The headline XDocs numbers for the last 7, 30 or 90 days: views against the previous period, visitors, reading time, completion, the top documents / rooms / links / visitors, devices, and the share of anonymous views.

params.name: days
params.description: Default 30.

tools.name: xdocs_close_file_request
tools.description: Close an XDocs file request (active=false — the link says so instead of accepting files) or reopen it (active=true). Uploads already received stay.

params.name: active
params.description: Default false (close).

tools.name: xdocs_create_document
tools.description: Create an XDocs document from Markdown, from HTML, or from one of the account's saved templates (template_id — cannot be combined with a body). Optionally give it a signing list (recipients) now. A document written from Markdown has NO signature fields: before it can be sent for signature, call xdocs_add_signature_block once per signer. A template already has its fields, and recipients passed alongside template_id fill its slots in order. Write FINISHED text: XDocs refuses to send a document that still holds a placeholder ([COMPANY NAME], TBD, blank lines to fill in) — ask the user for the missing facts rather than leaving a gap. Returns the new document and any Markdown conversion warnings.

params.name: title
params.description: 1–200 characters. Optional with template_id.

params.name: markdown
params.description: The body, as Markdown (up to 500,000 characters). Headings, lists, quotes, tables and $…$ math are read; images are not.

params.name: html
params.description: The body, as HTML (instead of markdown).

params.name: template_id
params.description: Start from a saved template (see xdocs_list_templates). Not combinable with markdown/html.

params.name: recipients
params.description: The signing list, up to 30.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: File it in a workspace folder (see xdocs_list_folders).

tools.name: xdocs_create_document_comment
tools.description: Leave a comment on an XDocs document, optionally as a reply (parent_id) or anchored to a quoted passage. The document owner, the thread and anyone @-mentioned are emailed, as they would be from the editor. Returns who was notified.

params.name: body
params.description: Up to 10,000 characters. @name mentions are notified.

params.name: parent_id
params.description: Reply into an existing thread: the id of the comment that OPENED it (threads are one level deep — a reply's id is refused).

params.name: quote
params.description: The passage being commented on, up to 2,000 characters.

tools.name: xdocs_create_folder
tools.description: Create a document folder in the XDocs workspace, after the existing ones. File documents into it with folder_id on xdocs_create_document or xdocs_update_document.

params.name: name
params.description: 1–120 characters.

tools.name: xdocs_create_link
tools.description: Publish a tracked XDocs link to one document or one data room, with whatever gates the user wants (see the settings). Returns the URL to share. Defaults: private, visitors must give their email, views are watermarked, downloads are off, the owner is emailed on every open. Pass deal_id to attach the DOCUMENT to a deal: every future read of that document then lands on the deal's timeline — including reads by people you never emailed, which is what a forwarded deck produces.

params.name: document_id
params.description: Exactly one of document_id and room_id.

params.name: room_id
params.description: Exactly one of document_id and room_id.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: Optional deal to attribute this document's reads to (documents only, not rooms).

params.name: name
params.description: How the link is labelled in analytics.

params.name: is_public
params.description: PUBLISH the document: anyone with the address reads it immediately and search engines are asked to index the page. Forces require_email, require_email_verification, password and require_nda OFF whatever else you pass, so every read is anonymous and none can land on a person or a deal. Default false. Only on the user's explicit say-so.

params.name: require_email
params.description: Ask a visitor who they are before they can read. Default true — without it views are anonymous and cannot land on a deal. Ignored when is_public is true.

params.name: require_email_verification
params.description: Email the visitor a six-digit code and check it. Implies require_email.

params.name: password
params.description: Protect the link with a password. Pass an empty string to remove one.

params.name: expires_at
params.description: When the link stops answering. Send the user's local wall-clock time with no offset (e.g. 2026-12-31T17:00); it is converted in their timezone. Empty string clears it.

params.name: max_views
params.description: Stop answering after this many visits. 0 clears it.

params.name: allow_download
params.description: Let visitors download a PDF copy. Default false.

params.name: watermark
params.description: Watermark every page with the viewer's identity. Default true.

params.name: watermark_text
params.description: Custom watermark text. Placeholders: {email}, {date}, {time}, {ip}, {link}. Empty string restores the default.

params.name: require_nda
params.description: Ask the visitor to accept confidentiality terms before reading.

params.name: nda_text
params.description: Terms written on the link itself (with require_nda).

params.name: agreement_id
params.description: Terms from the agreements library instead of nda_text (see xdocs_list_agreements).

params.name: allowed_emails
params.description: Only these addresses may read — or anyone at allowed_domains, when both are set. Up to 200.

params.name: allowed_domains
params.description: Only addresses at these domains may read, matched EXACTLY: 'acme.com' does not admit 'eu.acme.com'. Up to 200.

params.name: blocked_emails
params.description: Never these. An entry with no @ in the middle ('rival.com' or '@rival.com') blocks everyone at that domain. Up to 200.

params.name: notify_on_view
params.description: Email the owner when somebody opens it. Default true.

params.name: capture_fields
params.description: Up to 8 extra questions asked with the visitor's email (e.g. 'Fund name'). Answers come back on each view. Replaces the whole list.

params.name: tags
params.description: Labels for filtering links: up to 20, each ONE word of up to 32 characters (a space splits it into two). Replaces the whole list.

params.name: screenshot_protection
params.description: Deter casual copying: printing is blocked and the page hides when the window loses focus. Default false.

params.name: allow_assistant
params.description: Let the reader ask an AI questions about the document. Default false.

params.name: allow_audio
params.description: Let the reader have the document read aloud. Default false.

params.name: allow_feedback
params.description: Show a reaction bar under the document. Default false.

params.name: bulk_download_otp
params.description: Room links only: require an emailed code before a zip of everything. Default true.

params.name: og_title
params.description: Title of the preview card when the link is pasted into chat or social. Empty string restores the default.

params.name: og_description
params.description: The line under that title. Empty string clears it.

params.name: og_image_url
params.description: http(s) image for the preview card (1200×630 previews best). Empty string restores the default.

tools.name: xdocs_create_room
tools.description: Create an empty XDocs data room. File documents into it with xdocs_file_document_in_room, add folders with xdocs_create_room_folder, then publish a link with xdocs_create_link (room_id).

tools.name: xdocs_create_room_folder
tools.description: Add a folder to an XDocs data room, appended after the existing ones.

tools.name: xdocs_delete_document
tools.description: Move an XDocs document to the trash (restorable with xdocs_restore_document). purge=true deletes it outright, and only works on a document already in the trash that has never been sent for signature. A document out for signature cannot be deleted at all — void the envelope first. Confirm with the user before purging.

params.name: purge
params.description: Permanently delete (only from the trash).

tools.name: xdocs_delete_link
tools.description: Remove an XDocs share link. It stops answering at once; its visit history is kept as evidence of who read what. To pause instead of remove, use xdocs_update_link with active=false.

tools.name: xdocs_document_analytics
tools.description: Where readers spent their attention in ONE XDocs document, section by section (per page for a PDF): readers, total and median time, time per hundred words, friction, how many stopped there, and what share reached each section. Optionally only visits through one link. Use it to answer 'which part of the deck loses people'.

tools.name: xdocs_file_document_in_room
tools.description: File one of the account's documents into an XDocs data room, at the top level or in a folder. Idempotent: filing a document already in the room MOVES it. Refused while the room is frozen (xdocs_update_room frozen=false first).

params.name: folder_id
params.description: A folder in this room; omit for the top level.

tools.name: xdocs_get_document
tools.description: Read one XDocs document: title, kind, status, folder, its signing list (recipients with ids — needed for xdocs_add_signature_block, and to send back on xdocs_update_document so their signature fields stay bound), the file under it, and optionally its body as Markdown. Use include_content only when you need the text. An uploaded PDF or shared file has no text body to return.

params.name: include_content
params.description: Also return the body, as Markdown (authored documents only).

tools.name: xdocs_get_envelope
tools.description: One XDocs envelope's full status: who sent it, every party (signed / declined / delegated / viewed / waiting — and whether their signing email BOUNCED), how many fields are complete, reminders, expiry, and the completion hash once done. Use it to answer 'did they sign yet?' and 'did the request even arrive?'. If the envelope is attached to a deal, this also refreshes the deal's record.

tools.name: xdocs_get_envelope_certificate
tools.description: The evidence behind a completed XDocs envelope as data: signers, consent records, authentication, the audit trail, and whether the stored document and completion digests still verify. Use when someone asks whether an executed agreement is intact or who exactly signed and when.

tools.name: xdocs_get_file_request
tools.description: One XDocs file request with its items, assignees and what has arrived so far.

tools.name: xdocs_get_link
tools.description: One XDocs share link and its gates. The password is reported as has_password, never returned.

tools.name: xdocs_get_room
tools.description: One XDocs data room with its state (frozen / archived), folders and filed documents, in the order a visitor sees them.

tools.name: xdocs_get_view
tools.description: One XDocs visit with its per-section reading (per page for a PDF): which sections held attention and which were skipped.

tools.name: xdocs_get_visitor
tools.description: One person's XDocs reading history by email, with their most recent visits (up to 100). 'Not found' means no visits from that address, not that the person does not exist.

tools.name: xdocs_link_document_to_deal
tools.description: Attach an XDocs document to a Kavanah deal so that every read of it (through any link, by anyone) lands on that deal's timeline as engagement. This is what rescues a forwarded deck — someone at the fund you never emailed opens it, and the view still counts. Pass deal_id as null to detach. Reads by a known contact on an open deal attribute without this; it exists for everyone else.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: The deal, or null to detach.

tools.name: xdocs_list_agreements
tools.description: The XDocs agreements library: confidentiality terms written once and picked by id on any link (agreement_id). Shows how many links use each and how many people accepted it.

tools.name: xdocs_list_audit_events
tools.description: The XDocs audit trail, newest first — every recorded event across signing, sharing and documents: what happened, to what, by whom, from where. This is the EVIDENCE trail (as opposed to analytics, which is about attention). Filter by family (signing / sharing / documents), one event type (e.g. recipient.signed), search text, a date range, or one document / envelope / link.

params.name: type
params.description: One event type, e.g. 'recipient.signed', 'link.viewed'. An unknown type is refused.

params.name: q
params.description: Matches the description, actor name or actor email.

params.name: from
params.description: Send the user's local wall-clock time with no offset (e.g. 2026-12-31T17:00); it is converted in their timezone.

params.name: to
params.description: Send the user's local wall-clock time with no offset (e.g. 2026-12-31T17:00); it is converted in their timezone.

params.name: limit
params.description: Default 50, capped at 200.

tools.name: xdocs_list_deal_documents
tools.description: What has been sent to or read by one deal's counterparties, from Kavanah's own record, so it still answers after the connection has lapsed. Three lists: the e-signature envelopes attached to the deal with their current status and per-signer detail, the XDocs documents attached to the deal (and the link most recently published for each), and the recent reads attributed to the deal — with reading time brought up to date from XDocs when the connection is live. Use it to answer 'did they sign?' and 'has anyone at the fund actually read the deck?'.

tools.name: xdocs_list_document_comments
tools.description: The comment thread on an XDocs document, oldest first. resolved=false shows only what is still open.

tools.name: xdocs_list_document_versions
tools.description: An XDocs document's version history, newest first: named restore points and the automatic snapshots taken before every body replacement. Use with xdocs_restore_document_version.

tools.name: xdocs_list_documents
tools.description: List the connected XDocs account's documents, most recently edited first. Returns id, title, kind (xdoc = authored, pdf = uploaded, file = shared file), status (draft, or locked = out for signature), page count and the active envelope id if any. Filter by search text, status or kind. Use this to find a document id before sending, sharing or filing it.

params.name: q
params.description: Search titles and body text.

params.name: status
params.description: draft, or locked (out for signature). Anything else is rejected by XDocs.

params.name: kind
params.description: xdoc = authored, pdf = uploaded PDF, file = a shared file of any other type (can be linked and filed, never signed).

params.name: folder_id
params.description: Only documents in this workspace folder (see xdocs_list_folders).

params.name: in_library
params.description: true for the curated library only.

params.name: trashed
params.description: true lists deleted documents instead of live ones.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows to return. Default 25, capped at 100.

tools.name: xdocs_list_envelopes
tools.description: Envelopes sent from the connected XDocs account, newest first, each with its parties and status (sent, completed, declined, voided, expired). Filter by one status.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows to return. Default 25, capped at 100.

tools.name: xdocs_list_file_requests
tools.description: XDocs file requests (ask named people for named documents), most recently changed first, with progress counts.

tools.name: xdocs_list_folders
tools.description: The XDocs workspace's document folders, in dashboard order, with how many live documents each holds — where the folder_id used by xdocs_list_documents, xdocs_create_document and xdocs_update_document comes from. Not a data room's folders (see xdocs_get_room).

tools.name: xdocs_list_links
tools.description: Tracked XDocs share links, newest first, each with its URL, whether it is PUBLIC, its gates (email required, verification, password, NDA, expiry, view cap, allowed domains, download, watermark), tags and reader features. Filter to one document or one data room, or to active links only.

params.name: active
params.description: true for links that still answer.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows to return. Default 25, capped at 100.

tools.name: xdocs_list_questions
tools.description: Questions readers asked from inside an XDocs link, those waiting on an answer first. awaiting=true shows only threads where the reader spoke last. Filter by document, room, link or asker email.

tools.name: xdocs_list_rooms
tools.description: The account's XDocs data rooms — many documents behind one set of gates, in folders, with reading attributed per file — and whether each is FROZEN (contents locked, links still serving) or ARCHIVED (every link closed).

params.name: archived
params.description: false for the rooms the app lists, true for archived ones only. Omit for both.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows to return. Default 25, capped at 100.

tools.name: xdocs_list_templates
tools.description: The account's saved XDocs templates, most recently changed first, with their recipient slots. A template keeps its signature fields and recipient slots but never the addresses, so a document made from one is ready to send once its recipients are supplied.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows to return. Default 25, capped at 100.

tools.name: xdocs_list_views
tools.description: Visits to XDocs links, newest first: who (and the name they typed accepting terms), when first and last opened, active reading time (time accrues only while a section is on screen and the tab is active — attention, not tab-left-open), separate sittings, completion, whether they downloaded or accepted the NDA, their answers to the link's capture questions, and where from. One visit is one person on one link, accumulating across every return. A visit counts once every gate was cleared. Filter by document, room, link, viewer email or a since-datetime. This is engagement evidence: an investor who read 100% of the deck twice is a different conversation from one who opened page 1.

params.name: since
params.description: Visits started at or after this. Send the user's local wall-clock time with no offset (e.g. 2026-12-31T17:00); it is converted in their timezone.

params.name: include_unopened
params.description: Also list visits that never cleared the gates.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows to return. Default 25, capped at 100.

tools.name: xdocs_list_visitors
tools.description: XDocs visits grouped by the PERSON who made them — not 'opened nine times' but 'this person has read four documents for an hour'. Per visitor: views, documents, total reading time, average completion, first/last seen, verified, accepted NDA, downloaded. Only visits that captured an address count. Filter by document, room, link, one email, or since.

params.name: email
params.description: One visitor, by the address they gave.

params.name: since
params.description: Send the user's local wall-clock time with no offset (e.g. 2026-12-31T17:00); it is converted in their timezone.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows to return. Default 25, capped at 100.

tools.name: xdocs_reassign_signer
tools.description: Move an outstanding signature on an XDocs envelope to somebody else — the fields follow the new person, who is emailed, and the original stays on the envelope as delegated. Fails if that recipient already signed, declined, or passed it on, or if the address is unchanged.

params.name: recipient_id
params.description: From xdocs_get_envelope.

params.name: reason
params.description: Recorded in the audit trail.

tools.name: xdocs_remove_document_from_room
tools.description: Take a document out of an XDocs data room. The document itself is untouched.

tools.name: xdocs_resolve_document_comment
tools.description: Resolve (or reopen with resolved=false) a comment thread on an XDocs document. Pass the thread's FIRST comment — a reply cannot be resolved on its own. Works on anyone's thread.

params.name: resolved
params.description: Default true.

tools.name: xdocs_restore_document
tools.description: Bring an XDocs document back from the trash.

tools.name: xdocs_restore_document_version
tools.description: Put an earlier version of an XDocs document back. What it replaces is snapshotted first, so a restore is itself undoable via another restore. Fails while the document is out for signature.

tools.name: xdocs_save_as_template
tools.description: Save an XDocs document as a reusable template (its recipient slots and fields are kept; addresses are stripped).

params.name: name
params.description: Defaults to the document's title plus 'template'.

tools.name: xdocs_send_envelope
tools.description: Send a prepared XDocs document for signature. THIS DISPATCHES THE SIGNATURE-REQUEST EMAILS IMMEDIATELY — there is no draft step, so confirm the document and every recipient with the user first unless they already specified both precisely. Prerequisites: the document is a draft with at least one signer, each with a name, an address and at least one field to complete (xdocs_add_signature_block). XDocs also refuses (and sends nothing) while the document is unfinished: a placeholder left in the text ([COMPANY NAME], TBD), an unresolved suggestion, or a signature line with no field — the reply names which; fix it with xdocs_update_document and send again. A shared file cannot be signed at all. A refusal saying the plan's sends are used is about the user's XDocs account, not Kavanah credits. Sending freezes a snapshot; later edits cannot change what a signer was shown, and the document stays locked until the envelope ends. Pass deal_id whenever the agreement belongs to a deal: it puts 'Sent for signature' on that deal's timeline and every later signature/decline/void/expiry is written there automatically. Returns the envelope and per-recipient delivery — the envelope is real and its links work even when one notification bounced, so report a bounce, do not re-send.

params.name: subject
params.description: Email subject, up to 300 characters. Defaults to 'Please sign: <title>'.

params.name: message
params.description: A note inside the email, up to 2,000 characters.

params.name: sequential
params.description: true routes signers one after another; false sends to everybody at once.

params.name: expires_at
params.description: When it stops accepting signatures. Send the user's local wall-clock time with no offset (e.g. 2026-12-31T17:00); it is converted in their timezone.

params.name: reminder_every_days
params.description: 1–30. Nudge whoever is holding it up on this cadence.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: Optional deal to attach this envelope to. When set, the deal timeline tracks it from send through completion without anyone asking.

tools.name: xdocs_send_envelope_reminder
tools.description: Nudge whoever an XDocs envelope is waiting on — on a sequential envelope that is one person, not everybody unsigned. Sends an email now. Fails if the envelope has ended or nobody is currently waiting.

tools.name: xdocs_send_file_request
tools.description: Ask named people for named documents through XDocs. EACH ASSIGNEE IS EMAILED THEIR OWN UPLOAD LINK AT ONCE — confirm the list and the items with the user first. Whatever arrives becomes a document in the XDocs workspace, filed into the room/folder given. Use for diligence checklists: 'send the fund our standard DD request list'.

params.name: items
params.description: What is wanted, up to 50.

params.name: assignees
params.description: Up to 50, each mailed their own link.

params.name: room_id
params.description: Room the uploads are filed into.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: A folder in that room. Needs room_id.

params.name: due_at
params.description: When it is due. Send the user's local wall-clock time with no offset (e.g. 2026-12-31T17:00); it is converted in their timezone.

params.name: remind_every_days
params.description: 1–60. Reminder cadence for whoever has not finished.

tools.name: xdocs_send_file_request_invites
tools.description: Add people to an existing XDocs file request. EACH ONE IS EMAILED THEIR OWN UPLOAD LINK AT ONCE — confirm the list with the user first. Somebody already on the request is not added twice: their name is updated and they are mailed again (a fresh invitation if the first never arrived, otherwise a reminder). The request's items and room are fixed once it exists.

params.name: assignees
params.description: 1–50 people.

tools.name: xdocs_send_question_reply
tools.description: Answer a reader's question in its XDocs thread. The reply is EMAILED to the asker when the link captured their address. Confirm the wording with the user before sending unless they dictated it.

params.name: body
params.description: Up to 5,000 characters.

tools.name: xdocs_update_document
tools.description: Change an XDocs document: retitle it, replace its body (the previous body is snapshotted to version history first, so this is recoverable — name that snapshot with version_label), replace its signing list, or move it between workspace folders and the curated library. recipients REPLACES the whole list: send back every recipient you are keeping WITH their id (from xdocs_get_document) — a recipient without an id is treated as somebody new with nothing yet to sign, and their old signature fields are orphaned so the document can no longer be sent. A new body on a document out for signature returns a conflict — void the envelope first.

params.name: markdown
params.description: Replaces the whole body.

params.name: version_label
params.description: Names the restore point taken before the body is replaced.

params.name: recipients
params.description: Replaces the signing list, up to 30.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: Move it into this workspace folder (see xdocs_list_folders), or null to take it out of one.

params.name: in_library
params.description: Add it to (true) or remove it from (false) the curated library.

tools.name: xdocs_update_link
tools.description: Change an XDocs share link's gates or settings; omitted fields are kept. active=false switches it off (and true back on). TIGHTENING A GATE RE-GATES VISITORS WHO ALREADY CLEARED IT — adding a password or an NDA is felt by every existing reader on their next open, so say so when the user asks for it.

params.name: name
params.description: How the link is labelled in analytics.

params.name: is_public
params.description: PUBLISH the document: anyone with the address reads it immediately and search engines are asked to index the page. Forces require_email, require_email_verification, password and require_nda OFF whatever else you pass, so every read is anonymous and none can land on a person or a deal. Default false. Only on the user's explicit say-so.

params.name: require_email
params.description: Ask a visitor who they are before they can read. Default true — without it views are anonymous and cannot land on a deal. Ignored when is_public is true.

params.name: require_email_verification
params.description: Email the visitor a six-digit code and check it. Implies require_email.

params.name: password
params.description: Protect the link with a password. Pass an empty string to remove one.

params.name: expires_at
params.description: When the link stops answering. Send the user's local wall-clock time with no offset (e.g. 2026-12-31T17:00); it is converted in their timezone. Empty string clears it.

params.name: max_views
params.description: Stop answering after this many visits. 0 clears it.

params.name: allow_download
params.description: Let visitors download a PDF copy. Default false.

params.name: watermark
params.description: Watermark every page with the viewer's identity. Default true.

params.name: watermark_text
params.description: Custom watermark text. Placeholders: {email}, {date}, {time}, {ip}, {link}. Empty string restores the default.

params.name: require_nda
params.description: Ask the visitor to accept confidentiality terms before reading.

params.name: nda_text
params.description: Terms written on the link itself (with require_nda).

params.name: agreement_id
params.description: Terms from the agreements library instead of nda_text (see xdocs_list_agreements).

params.name: allowed_emails
params.description: Only these addresses may read — or anyone at allowed_domains, when both are set. Up to 200.

params.name: allowed_domains
params.description: Only addresses at these domains may read, matched EXACTLY: 'acme.com' does not admit 'eu.acme.com'. Up to 200.

params.name: blocked_emails
params.description: Never these. An entry with no @ in the middle ('rival.com' or '@rival.com') blocks everyone at that domain. Up to 200.

params.name: notify_on_view
params.description: Email the owner when somebody opens it. Default true.

params.name: capture_fields
params.description: Up to 8 extra questions asked with the visitor's email (e.g. 'Fund name'). Answers come back on each view. Replaces the whole list.

params.name: tags
params.description: Labels for filtering links: up to 20, each ONE word of up to 32 characters (a space splits it into two). Replaces the whole list.

params.name: screenshot_protection
params.description: Deter casual copying: printing is blocked and the page hides when the window loses focus. Default false.

params.name: allow_assistant
params.description: Let the reader ask an AI questions about the document. Default false.

params.name: allow_audio
params.description: Let the reader have the document read aloud. Default false.

params.name: allow_feedback
params.description: Show a reaction bar under the document. Default false.

params.name: bulk_download_otp
params.description: Room links only: require an emailed code before a zip of everything. Default true.

params.name: og_title
params.description: Title of the preview card when the link is pasted into chat or social. Empty string restores the default.

params.name: og_description
params.description: The line under that title. Empty string clears it.

params.name: og_image_url
params.description: http(s) image for the preview card (1200×630 previews best). Empty string restores the default.

tools.name: xdocs_update_room
tools.description: Rename or re-describe an XDocs data room, freeze or unfreeze it, archive or restore it. FROZEN locks the contents (nothing filed, moved or removed — those calls are refused) while every link keeps serving exactly what is there; unfreeze to change what is filed. ARCHIVED retires the room: every link into it immediately answers with a closed page until archived=false puts it back — confirm with the user before archiving a room people are reading.

params.name: name
params.description: 1–200 characters.

params.name: description
params.description: Up to 2,000 characters.

tools.name: xdocs_void_envelope
tools.description: Cancel an XDocs envelope in flight. Everyone outstanding is told the reason and the document returns to draft (and can be edited again). Irreversible for that envelope — a corrected agreement is a new send. Confirm with the user first.

params.name: reason
params.description: Up to 500 characters. Sent to the recipients and written to the audit trail.
